name: Avalara
summary: Avalara sells rooftop-accurate tax calculation, economic nexus tracking and automated filing in one Core Compliance plan at $79 per state per month, with a three-state minimum. A second plan at $69 per state per month adds Streamlined Sales Tax services, including a single SST registration ID and state-funded calculation and filing in up to 25 states for qualifying sellers.

facts.text: Core Compliance does not include registration in states outside the Streamlined Sales Tax program, which Avalara treats as a separate service.
Avalara says AvaTax has achieved SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.
Avalara cites more than 1,400 signed partner integrations plus an API.
The SST plan page says the program covers 24 member and associate states plus Pennsylvania, and non-SST states cost $69 per state per month.
Businesses with $50 million or more in annual revenue are sent to a custom plan with no published price.

plans.name: Core Compliance
plans.notes: Or $799 per state per year. Minimum of 3 states
